English translation from the Modern Amharic of the EOTC Bible (nehemiah-osc.org) by Claude (Anthropic) with collaborator, May 2026. Apparatus integrates Josef Horovitz, 'Das äthiopische Maccabäerbuch,' Zeitschrift für Assyriologie XIX (1905), pp. 194-233 — PD primary scholarly study. 64-citation third-pass audit verdict matrix; 57 verified, 4 errors corrected, 3 interpretive readings flagged, 7 newly discovered parallels added. Dating widened to Aksumite-to-Solomonic Ethiopian Christian range (4th-14th c. CE); precise composition date undetermined in current scholarship per Horovitz 1905 non-commitment. Three books: 1 Mq 36 chapters (Maqabis-of-Benjamin martyrology vs Ṣiruṣaydan); 2 Mq 21 chapters (Maqabis-of-Moab conversion + sons' martyrdom + Ṣiruṣaydan's death); 3 Mq 10 chapters (homiletic + angelological dialogue + Satan-refused-Adam tradition + resurrection-doctrine).

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) First Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I) (c. 600 AD)

OPENS Ch 27 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: pre-narrative-capstone arc. The chapter likely develops the LATE-PROPHETIC arc preparing Ch 28's salvation-history-compression (γ.4.8 seed: Cain-to-Esther). The late-prophetic theme parallels: HAGGAI 2:1-9 (the rebuilding-of-the-Temple prophetic-encouragement); ZECHARIAH 4 + 6:9-15 (the Zerubbabel + Joshua high-priest-and-king prophetic-pair); MALACHI 4:5-6 (Elijah-to-come prophecy — paired with Mt 17:10-13 par.); JOHN THE BAPTIST'S MINISTRY (Mt 3 + Mk 1 + Lk 3 + Jn 1 — the Elijah-typology forerunner); MATTHEW 11:7-15 par. (Christ's interpretation of John-as-Elijah). Patristic-tradition: JUSTIN MARTYR Dialogue with Trypho 49 (Elijah-and-John typology); ORIGEN Commentary on Matthew 12 (the Elijah-John-typology); JEROME Commentary on Malachi (the foundational Latin Malachi-interpretation). Tewahedo prophetic-tradition preserves the Elijah-typology as Tewahedo-eschatological-anchor — the Meqabyan chapter likely articulates a pre-eschatological-capstone arc drawing on this Elijah-typology framework.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of MESSIANIC-EXPECTATION theme. The messianic-expectation theme parallels: GENESIS 49:8-12 (Jacob's-blessing-of-Judah — Shiloh prophecy); NUMBERS 24:17 (Balaam's-star-out-of-Jacob); 2 SAMUEL 7:12-16 + PSALM 89:3-4 (the Davidic-messianic covenant); ISAIAH 7:14 (the virgin-shall-conceive); ISAIAH 9:6-7 ('unto us a child is born'); ISAIAH 11:1-10 (the rod-from-Jesse); ISAIAH 53 (the Suffering-Servant); MICAH 5:2 (Bethlehem-ruler-prophecy); ZECHARIAH 9:9 + 12:10 (the humble-king + pierced-one); MALACHI 3:1-3 (the messenger-of-the-covenant); MATTHEW 1 par.
